newsitem.title: GERMANY: Trinkaus rates Telekom shares underweight.
newsitem.headline: Trinkaus rates Telekom shares underweight.

text.p: Trinkaus Capital Management said on Monday it had assigned an "underweight" recommendation to shares in Deutsche Telekom AG, the telecommunications group floated last November.
Telecommunications analysts of Telekom's underwriting banks were not allowed to publish research or comment on the stock until last Friday.
Trinkaus analyst Klaus Repke said he expected Telekom shares to move sideways between 30 and 32 marks ($20.19) until the group publishes its 1996 results in May.
Telekom's share price was under pressure as a result of issues of telecommunications company shares in Spain, France and Hungary, Repke said.
